# Vendored PaddleOCR Android SDK

Upstream: https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR/tree/main/deploy/ppocr-android/ppocr-sdk

Integrated as Gradle module `:ppocr-sdk` for PP-OCRv6 ONNX on-device OCR.
`build.gradle.kts` adapted for this repo's version catalog; Java/Kotlin sources kept from upstream.
